comments.description: Operations to apply to the comments on the diagram

$add.description: Add new comments to the diagram, keyed by comment id

$remove.description: Remove comments from the diagram by id

$replace.description: Replace all comments on the diagram, keyed by comment id

$update.description: Update existing comments on the diagram, keyed by comment id

commit.description: The commit number of the diagram content, incremented on each change

connections.description: Operations to apply to the connections on the diagram

$add.description: Add new connections to the diagram, keyed by connection id

$remove.description: Remove connections from the diagram by id

$replace.description: Replace all connections on the diagram, keyed by connection id

$update.description: Update existing connections on the diagram, keyed by connection id

objects.description: Operations to apply to the objects on the diagram

$add.description: Add new objects to the diagram, keyed by object id

$remove.description: Remove objects from the diagram by id

$replace.description: Replace all objects on the diagram, keyed by object id

$update.description: Update existing objects on the diagram, keyed by object id
